mechanic.summary: Existing bear echoes charge the incapacitated Zul'jarra and collide with the first player in their path.
mechanic.response: Assign players to intercept every charging echo before it reaches Zul'jarra; plan for echoes to persist into one additional cycle.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Den guide and linked spell record.
